style_suffix: Photorealistic live-action footage, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 35mm prime at f4, natural tripod steadiness, true-to-life colour, realistic atmospheric haze and depth of field. Bright high-altitude daylight under a luminous overcast sky, clean airy light, brilliant white snow, pale blue distance, dark green conifer. Well exposed and open, never dim, never dusk, never night. Fine real-world texture: granite grain, snow crust, lichen, running meltwater. Not an illustration, not a painting, not CGI, not a render, no stylisation, no HDR look, no oversaturation. No people, no buildings, no roads, no cable cars, no animals, no text, no camera movement, no cuts. The movement is continuous and sustained for the entire shot, constantly replenished, never settling, never dissipating, never coming to rest.
notes: 1080p at 450 credits per clip. Same 15-shot, 15-second structure. Style suffix mirrors edition 02's, which produced consistently photoreal results - only the palette and the excluded objects change. Alpine has a specific failure mode: static rock and snow with nothing moving. Every shot names a moving element (cloud, meltwater, spindrift, grass, mist) so no clip renders as a still. First probes of 01 and 13 came back too dark and near-motionless (mean frame delta 0.88 and 0.52 against 1.65 for edition 02's calmest shot). 'Slate' and 'cool blue-grey' were reading as dusk, and 'gentle motion' let the movement dissipate mid-shot, so the suffix now names bright high-altitude light and demands sustained, replenished motion.

shots.prompt: Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A high granite ridgeline with a steady unending river of cloud pouring over the crest and spilling down the far side, fresh cloud constantly arriving from behind the ridge so the flow never thins or stops. Bright pale sky above, sunlit rock and snow patches beneath.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A still glacial lake of pale milky turquoise, its surface stirred by the faintest wind ripple, bare scree slopes rising behind and fading into thin mountain haze.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Clear meltwater running fast over dark granite slabs and dropping in small continuous falls into a shallow pool, white threads of water braiding endlessly. Lichen and wet stone.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A snow-covered summit ridge with fine spindrift streaming continuously off the crest in the wind, catching the pale light. Deep blue shadowed snow below, thin cloud drifting past.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A high alpine meadow of fine grass rippling in a steady wind, scattered grey boulders, snow patches lingering in the hollows, dark peaks rising into cloud behind.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Looking down from above onto a sea of cloud filling a deep valley, the white surface rolling and shifting slowly, dark ridge tops standing out like islands, receding paler into the distance.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Snow-laden subalpine firs standing in still cold air as fine snow falls steadily and continuously through the frame, branches heavy and white, everything soft grey behind.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A small dark mountain tarn mirroring the peaks above, the reflection trembling and reforming as light wind crosses the water. Boulders and coarse alpine grass at the edge.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A vast scree slope of grey shattered rock with mist drifting slowly across it in layers, continually revealing and hiding the slope above. Cold flat light.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. The blue crevassed snout of a glacier, meltwater running in thin continuous streams down its ice face and dripping steadily from the lip. Deep blue ice, grey moraine below.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A tall thin waterfall falling down a dark mountain cliff face, breaking into drifting spray partway down that blows sideways on the wind. Wet black rock, pale mist below.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A slope of alpine larch in autumn gold, needles trembling in a light breeze, low cloud moving slowly through the trees and thinning to reveal grey peaks behind.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A bright open snowfield in a strong steady wind, with long visible streamers of loose surface snow racing low and fast across the frame from left to right without pause, ground blizzard blowing continuously over sculpted white sastrugi. Brilliant white snow, pale sunlit ridges beyond.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Extreme close view of pale green and orange lichen on weathered granite with meltwater trickling continuously over the stone and beading on the crust. Soft grey bokeh of the slope behind.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Wide elevated view across an endless range of snow-streaked peaks, cloud shadows and thin cloud banks drifting slowly across the ridges, each range paler than the last into the distance.
